page_title: LIV 2-1 BHA | Liverpool v Brighton 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
90+5' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+4' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dominik Szoboszlai walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
90+4' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
90+2' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Pervis Estupinan will be replaced by Valentin Barco (Brighton).

90+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luis Diaz as he is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
88' A yellow card for a tackle by Wataru Endo (Liverpool). David Coote doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
87' Adam Lallana (Brighton) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' Substitution. Adam Lallana (Brighton) has come on for Jakub Moder.
83' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Evan Ferguson (Brighton) replaces Simon Adingra.
83' Substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) on for Darwin Nunez.
83' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

81' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher keeps it out.
77' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Bart Verbruggen makes a great save to stop his effort.
75' The resulting corner, taken by Pascal Gross (Brighton), comes to nothing.
73' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Liverpool due to an offside in the build-up play.
72' The Liverpool players halt their celebrations as referee David Coote makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
71' Goal! A great through ball by Mohamed Salah sets up Luis Diaz (Liverpool) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
71' David Coote shows a yellow card to Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) for a tough tackle.
70' That's the end of the game for Tariq Lamptey, who is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
69' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
68' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
67' A lofted cross from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
65' 2 - 1 Goal Mohamed Salah (Liverpool)! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) was put through by Alexis Mac Allister and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
64' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the bottom left corner, but is denied by a reflex save from Bart Verbruggen.
64' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
64' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
63' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
62' Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
58' Today's referee David Coote rightly decides to book Joe Gomez (Liverpool) for his harsh tackle.
58' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
57' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
57' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings an opponent down and David Coote interrupts the game.
55' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
54' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
53' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
50' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but David Coote ignores the protests.
50' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
48' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) was probably a bit loose with his words to David Coote, who decides to show him a yellow.
48' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits a rough foul. David Coote stops the game and makes a call.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45+4' David Coote has a clear sight and sees a foul from Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
45+3' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Brighton.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Brighton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
43' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes it short.

43' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.

38' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Bart Verbruggen pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner.
37' David Coote blows his whistle. Luis Diaz (Liverpool) commits a foul after dangerous play.
36' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
36' Jakub Moder (Brighton) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
35' What a big chance! Jakub Moder (Brighton) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
33' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Bart Verbruggen is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.

32' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Bart Verbruggen was alert and the score remained the same.
31' Chance! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
31' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
30' Jakub Moder (Brighton) is caught offside!
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
27' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
26' The linesman raises his flag. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
25' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
24' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
22' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
22' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
21' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' David Coote shows a yellow card to Pascal Gross (Brighton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
19' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
19' It looks like Simon Adingra (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. David Coote won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
18' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
18' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
18' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
17' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Luis Diaz (Liverpool) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
15' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
14' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sees a yellow card from David Coote after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
14' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) works the corner short.
14' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
13' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
12' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pascal Gross (Brighton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' The free kick is taken by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton), but ball is cleared.
10' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and David Coote blows for a foul.
9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
9' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Simon Adingra (Brighton) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
8' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
7' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

2' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the right side of the net.
1' The first half has started.
Brighton will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be David Coote.
